messages:
Jules: Quick results from the horizon-lite-9b int6 bring-up (mini-harness: 250 samples per slice). Short econ + ops notes below.

Ravi: Nice, what slices?

Jules: Chat (65%), retrieval (25%), document-extracts (10%). Top-line: infra cost per 1k tokens int8=$0.0117, int6=$0.0068 (~42% infra savings). Latency p95 int8=120ms, int6=210ms. Throughput -16% tokens/sec on int6.

Marta: And quality? Any hot spots?

Jules: Small avg drops but concentrated: chat QA -0.04 (5pt scale), retrieval MRR -0.85% abs, extract F1 -0.9 abs. Hallucination proxy +0.6% concentrated on numeric/date extraction and multi-step reasoning. CI noisy at 250; bootstrap MRR CI ~+/-0.5%.

Sam: So roughly 35-45% cost savings vs modest, targeted regressions. Recommend routing plan?

Jules: Operational proposal:
1) Hybrid routing: force int8 for any request with metadata.tags includes ["retrieval","billing","numeric-exact"].
2) Allow int6 for chat where estimated_tokens < 1200 and latency_sensitive != true.
3) Canary: run 1k-sample shadow for retrieval, then staged live: chat 5% int6, retrieval 15% int6 for 48h. Rollback gates: MRR drop >0.5% or hallucination_proxy +1.0%.
4) Prompt mitigations: post-filter numeric answers with a lightweight verifier; detect multi-step arithmetic -> force int8.

Jules: Example routing rule (pseudo):
```
route {
  match: request.meta.tags contains any of ["retrieval","billing","numeric-exact"]
  model: "horizon-lite-9b-int8"
  fallback: "horizon-lite-9b-int6"
}
route {
  match: request.meta.slice == "chat" && request.estimated_tokens < 1200
  model: "horizon-lite-9b-int6"
}
canary {
  route: "retrieval"
  traffic_pct: 15
  guard: { metric: "MRR", threshold: -0.5 }
}
```

Marta: GTN blurb draft?

Jules: "Int6 yields ~35-45% infra savings with small, concentrated quality regressions. Recommend hybrid routing: preserve int8 for high-precision retrieval and numeric-sensitive features; use int6 for bulk chat after a 1k shadow and 48h guarded canary. Add numeric post-filters and prompt guards to mitigate known failure modes."

CanaryBot: Canary queued: horizon-lite-9b-int6 chat route 5% start=2026-04-02T09:00Z. Monitors: Retrieval_MRR, Chat_MeanQA, latency_p95, hallucination_proxy.

Ravi: Action items: Jules run the 1k shadow for retrieval, Marta draft GTN one-pager, Sam add the numeric verifier and prompt detector tickets.

Jules: Will upload the 1k artifact and failure examples by EOD. :thumbsup:
